subject.title: Allow agents to harden bundled plugin discovery

question: Should model-driven gateway config writes be allowed to opt a migrated installation into strict bundled-plugin allowlist discovery without a separate operator action?
rationale: Current policy deliberately treats every new agent-writable config path as a security-boundary decision; source inspection can confirm that this patch is narrow, but it cannot decide whether this operator-owned plugin policy may be delegated to the model.

options.title: Approve the one-way exception
options.body: Authorize only `plugins.bundledDiscovery="allowlist"`, require the current-main port and exact-head guard plus live Gateway proof, and keep deletion or `"compat"` writes blocked.

options.title: Keep plugin policy operator-owned
options.body: Leave the fixed allowlist unchanged and close this PR and its linked issue, directing operators to Doctor, CLI, Control UI, or direct config editing.

recommendation.title: Approve the one-way exception
recommendation.body: Authorize only `plugins.bundledDiscovery="allowlist"`, require the current-main port and exact-head guard plus live Gateway proof, and keep deletion or `"compat"` writes blocked.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties steipete to both current configuration behavior and the advisory-backed gateway mutation boundary, with secops as the required reviewing team.
